sessions.title: INC37613121 — Emarsys key_id consultation
sessions.summary: Investigated customer inquiry from AL NABOODAH COMMERCIAL GROUP about changing Emarsys contact identifier from email (#3) to mobile (#37). Confirmed key_id is a plain config value with no CDP-side restriction. Drafted response with official doc link.

sessions.title: INC37675140 — Covestro Emarsys OAuth2 migration action mismatch
sessions.summary: Investigated email activity ingestion failures for Covestro after switching Emarsys connector auth from WSSE to OAuth2. Root cause: CX flow actions not auto-migrated to OAuth2-compatible v3 endpoint variants. Confirmed token URL is static https://auth.emarsys.net/oauth2/token (no tenant ID). 429 rate-limit errors self-resolved after 1 hour. 299 events need re-ingestion from Emarsys side.
